001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.jul;
002
003import java.time.Instant;
004import java.util.MissingResourceException;
005import java.util.ResourceBundle;
006import java.util.logging.LogRecord;
007
008import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
009
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMessageFormatter.StandardMessageFormatter;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter;
015
016/**
017 * Translates {@code java.util.logging.LogRecord} into Rainbow Gum
018 * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent} and routes it through {@link LogRouter#global()}.
019 * Shared by two independent JUL integration strategies: this module's own
020 * {@link java.util.logging.Handler}-based bridge ({@code SystemLoggerQueueJULHandler},
021 * installed on the default JUL root logger), and the separate
022 * <code>rainbowgum-jul-logmanager</code> module's {@code java.util.logging.LogManager}
023 * replacement (which routes every {@code java.util.logging.Logger} call directly,
024 * bypassing JUL's normal Handler/Level dispatch entirely). Kept here, exported, so
025 * neither integration duplicates the level mapping or event construction.
026 */
027public final class JULBridge {
028
029        private JULBridge() {
030        }
031
032        /*
033         * JUL has no context of its own so every registered contributor (SLF4J MDC, scoped
034         * key values, ...) applies.
035         */
036        private static final KeyValuesContributor KEY_VALUES = KeyValuesContributor.global();
037
038        private static final int TRACE_LEVEL_THRESHOLD = java.util.logging.Level.FINEST.intValue();
039
040        private static final int DEBUG_LEVEL_THRESHOLD = java.util.logging.Level.FINE.intValue();
041
042        private static final int INFO_LEVEL_THRESHOLD = java.util.logging.Level.INFO.intValue();
043
044        private static final int WARN_LEVEL_THRESHOLD = java.util.logging.Level.WARNING.intValue();
045
046        /**
047         * Maps a {@code java.util.logging.Level} to the closest
048         * {@link java.lang.System.Logger.Level}, the same threshold buckets JUL's own builtin
049         * levels (FINEST/FINE/INFO/WARNING/SEVERE) fall into, so custom intermediate levels
050         * still translate sensibly.
051         * @param level JUL level, including custom levels with arbitrary
052         * {@link java.util.logging.Level#intValue()}.
053         * @return closest matching System.Logger level.
054         */
055        public static System.Logger.Level toLevel(java.util.logging.Level level) {
056                int lv = level.intValue();
057                if (Integer.MIN_VALUE == lv) {
058                        return System.Logger.Level.TRACE;
059                }
060                else if (TRACE_LEVEL_THRESHOLD >= lv) {
061                        return System.Logger.Level.TRACE;
062                }
063                else if (DEBUG_LEVEL_THRESHOLD >= lv) {
064                        return System.Logger.Level.DEBUG;
065                }
066                else if (INFO_LEVEL_THRESHOLD >= lv) {
067                        return System.Logger.Level.INFO;
068                }
069                else if (WARN_LEVEL_THRESHOLD >= lv) {
070                        return System.Logger.Level.WARNING;
071                }
072                else if (Integer.MAX_VALUE == lv) {
073                        return System.Logger.Level.OFF;
074                }
075                return System.Logger.Level.ERROR;
076        }
077
078        /**
079         * Whether a logger name at a given JUL level is currently enabled, per Rainbow Gum's
080         * own level resolution rather than anything cached on a JUL
081         * {@code Logger}/{@code Handler}.
082         * @param loggerName logger name, as JUL would pass to
083         * {@link java.util.logging.Logger#getName()}.
084         * @param level JUL level being checked.
085         * @return true if a record at this name/level would actually be routed.
086         */
087        public static boolean isLoggable(String loggerName, java.util.logging.Level level) {
088                return LogRouter.global().route(loggerName, toLevel(level)).isEnabled();
089        }
090
091        /**
092         * Translates a JUL {@link LogRecord} into a Rainbow Gum event and routes it, if the
093         * record's logger name/level is currently enabled. A {@code null} record or a record
094         * with a {@code null} logger name is silently ignored, matching
095         * {@link java.util.logging.Handler#publish(LogRecord)}'s own contract for
096         * {@code null}.
097         * @param rec JUL log record, possibly {@code null}.
098         */
099        public static void publish(@Nullable LogRecord rec) {
100                if (rec == null) {
101                        return;
102                }
103                String loggerName = rec.getLoggerName();
104                if (loggerName == null) {
105                        return;
106                }
107                var level = toLevel(rec.getLevel());
108                var router = LogRouter.global();
109                var route = router.route(loggerName, level);
110                if (!route.isEnabled()) {
111                        return;
112                }
113                @Nullable Throwable cause = rec.getThrown();
114                @Nullable String msg = getMessage(rec);
115                var args = rec.getParameters();
116
117                Instant timestamp = rec.getInstant();
118                long threadId = rec.getLongThreadID();
119                String threadName = "";
120                /*
121                 * Ambient key values are only meaningful on the thread that made the record. A
122                 * handler publishing on another thread (async) would otherwise attach the
123                 * publishing thread's context to someone else's record.
124                 */
125                KeyValues keyValues = KeyValues.of();
126                long currentThreadId = Thread.currentThread().threadId();
127                if (currentThreadId == threadId) {
128                        threadName = Thread.currentThread().getName();
129                        keyValues = KEY_VALUES.keyValues();
130                }
131                // TODO fix caller info
132                var event = LogEvent.ofAll(timestamp, threadName, threadId, level, loggerName, msg, keyValues, cause,
133                                StandardMessageFormatter.JUL, args);
134                route.log(event);
135        }
136
137        private static @Nullable String getMessage(LogRecord record) {
138                String message = record.getMessage();
139                if (message == null) {
140                        return null;
141                }
142                ResourceBundle bundle = record.getResourceBundle();
143                if (bundle != null) {
144                        try {
145                                return bundle.getString(message);
146                        }
147                        catch (MissingResourceException e) {
148                                // no translation found - fall through and use the raw message instead
149                        }
150                }
151                return message;
152        }
153
154}
